title: Documents Pile Up
description: Customs paperwork for one shipment is rarely a single file. Confirm the Confirm step's document uploader accumulates a growing list rather than replacing the previous file each time.
successCondition: After a booking is confirmed, uploading a PDF and then a JPG through the customs document uploader results in a list showing exactly two entries — one per uploaded file, each with its own correct filename and mimeType — with the first upload's entry still present after the second upload completes, not overwritten.
hints: The upload input's value is cleared after each selection (e.target.value = ""), which is what allows selecting a same-named file again without the browser silently no-op'ing — but the list itself is additive state, check that separately.
Any combination of application/pdf, image/jpeg, or image/png works for this — the file content itself doesn't need to be a real document.
